Ca in imaginea atasata, sunt 2 pachete pro care ar fi trebuit sa expire pe data de 31/07/2026 , dar inca au statusul ca "true" in columul "is_pro" chiar daca a expirat.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend verification passed: seeded expired/future/permanent/null/missing PRO and VIP users in MongoDB, verified startup sweep after backend restart, verified GET /api/admin/users sweeps stale flags before returning data, and verified grant-pro/grant-vip future and permanent regressions.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable MongoDB users with email prefix bug-expiry-qa-8c334a00 during test; cleanup ran at script exit and removed the seeded users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test script restarted supervisor-managed backend, observed /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log startup message '[startup] expired 2 stale PRO/VIP subscription(s)', then authenticated as admin@streamhub.io and verified /api/admin/users response and MongoDB persistence for expired/future/permanent/null/missing PRO/VIP cases plus grant-pro/grant-vip regressions.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous behavior left expired is_pro/is_vip flags in MongoDB until a lazy user action occurred. The new sweeper is called at startup and before admin user listing; runtime evidence showed it flips stale flags and preserves future, permanent, null, and missing expiries. No mocked APIs were used.
